Deduplicates transaction streams and publishes unique transactions to downstream consumers.

# Purpose
`fd_dedup` implements a tile that receives transaction fragments from multiple input links, removes duplicates, and republishes unique transactions to downstream consumers. It handles three input kinds: gossip transactions, verified transactions, and executed-transaction signature messages. For gossip input, it parses the transaction before deduplication so the signature can be extracted. For executed transactions, it uses the signature message as the deduplication key and inserts it into the transaction cache. The tile also tracks bundle state for block-engine bundles and rejects repeated signatures inside the same bundle.

The file defines the tile context, scratch-space layout, input and output workspace setup, seccomp and file-descriptor policy, and the fragment callbacks used by `fd_stem`. The [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>) callback checks fragment bounds and copies or records data as needed, while [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>) performs signature-based deduplication and publishes non-duplicate transactions to the output dcache. The file ends by registering `fd_tile_dedup` as the runnable tile descriptor for the topology system.
